APPENDIX B — COVERAGE AND VERIFICATION MAP

Reader-facing pages have no dependencies on the historical tutorial tree.
Historical coverage audit: robot/ch6/{introduction,pitlogo,carpainting}.html.
Attribution remains in credits.md and the checkpoint's ARTWORK.txt.

appendix_b.md:
  Complete independently buildable tutorialb checkpoint and normal graphical race.
  Layered XCF, vector SVG and runtime SGI distinction; full-page decal replacement.
  Actual atlas mapping, UV guide, separate sides, bonnet, roof and rear wing.
  Stock source/model location and model-requested filename; source vs installed paths.
  Module/index/stock body lookup; index 1 distinguished from race array index 0.
  Paint edit, text/number edit, alpha preservation, real SGI export, 8-bit channels,
  power-of-two dimensions, RLE, readability at distance and texture seams.
  Current pit-wall UVs, approximately top 67 percent visible, uniform border,
  individual and shared-pit lookup, no speculative lower-third UI promises.
  Linux/Windows installation, image-only reload workflow, troubleshooting.
  Artwork authorship, editable source distribution and separate Free Art License.

Current source audit:
  graphic/ssggraph/grcar.cpp: body model/texture path (three directories),
    separate helper paths for wheel resources.
  grloadac.cpp and grssgext.h: body texture creation through loader options.
  grtexture.cpp: SGI channel handling, alpha and power-of-two requirement.
  grscene.cpp: side-pit logo lookup and exact u/v coordinate ranges.
  grutil.cpp and grtexture.h: state cache and teardown.
  raceengineclient/raceinit.cpp: team grouping, cars-per-pit assignment,
    driver index copied from registration / descriptor.
  car1-stock1.acc: car1-stock1.rgb body image and separate detail images.
  car1-stock1.xcf / adjacent readme.txt: source layers and Free Art attribution.

Maintenance:
  snapshot_texture_helpers.py reproduces the Appendix A controller with module,
  private-section, descriptor and deployment changes; --check detects drift.
  generate_texture_artwork.py recreates baseline artwork with GIMP 3, Inkscape,
  Pillow; not required to build/run/edit the finished checkpoint. It overwrites
  the baseline XCF, so do not use it to export student edits.
  package_texture_driver.py packages an explicit 34-file manifest.
  Two schematic SVGs are maintained directly. The 640-pixel atlas preview is
  composited over a checkerboard; the simulator image is a crop of a real render.

Validation (Linux):
  Independent extracted archive build without warnings; runtime XML/images/notices
  installed; all local includes and Windows build/deployment manifests checked.
  Six-lap baseline: 546.794 s, one pit stop, zero damage and penalty time.
  SGI headers/dimensions: body 1024x1024 RGBA, logo 256x256 RGB; alpha preserved.
  GIMP 3 SGI export of supplied XCF decodes pixel-identically to provided SGI image.
  Native graphical renderer, software OpenGL:
    module-level body image and pit logo rendered correctly;
    index-1 alternate paint and logo selected ahead of module files;
    shared pit (Tutorial B plus Tutorial A, same team, two cars per pit) uses
      B's module logo even while B uses its individual-index body texture;
    missing custom images select stock body and global data/textures/logo.rgb;
    paused pixels remain unchanged after replacing the logo on disk;
    abandoning and beginning a new session in the same process loads the edit.
  File-open traces confirm exact selected texture paths, not just visual similarity.
  Main screenshot uses the final short roof lettering. An earlier label crossed
  a UV boundary and was shortened after inspecting the car in the simulator.
  Screenshot quality update: same side camera (head 2, variant 0, default 30-degree
    vertical FOV) and grid placement, captured at 3840x2400 with actual 4x MSAA.
    Native crop (795,435,2280,1260), Lanczos preview 760x420, clickable native crop.
    A private module freezes at simulation time 2.206 s for matched framing;
    the installed production module and artwork are unchanged.
    Capture the TORCS window itself: Xvfb root captures can return stale frames.
  Graphical placement fixtures are appearance checks, not pit-service evidence.
  Production installed images restored after all alternate/fallback checks.
  Doxygen: zero warnings; local links, anchors, byte-identical downloads and images.
  Offline browser: all four Appendix B images load at 1280/1024 widths without
    overflow; both schematic SVGs pass text bounds/overlap checks.
  Clipboard: 62 real copies across the tutorial including Appendix B/platforms.
  Native Windows compilation/runtime remains unverified.
  Private simulator checks and logs remain outside source/downloads.
